candidate_selection: deterministic feasible solution; no requirement to globally maximize versions
metadata: Requires-Python, Requires-Dist version specifiers, environment markers and extras; every extra requested by any selected parent is activated until closure
only: pure Python py3-none-any wheels in the supplied directory
reject: direct URLs, editable/source distributions, malformed conflicting metadata, hash mismatch
lock: selected file SHA256, normalized name/version, active extras and reason edges; installation uses no dependency resolution
